generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A custom AST/IR/data-flow detector can appear structurally sound while silently omitting semantically equivalent syntax containers or reference forms.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Patch only the literal syntax that escaped instead of proving complete operation x container x reference-form coverage.
trigger_signals: structural prohibition implemented by syntax traversal

reusable_control.procedure: Vary forbidden operation semantics, AST/IR container placement and access/reference form independently, and retain a canonical allowed control.
reusable_control.expected: All semantically prohibited siblings are rejected without rejecting the canonical allowed path.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Prefer complete recursive AST/IR traversal and require an explicit operation x container x reference-form matrix before closing a structural guard.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Adversarial review must move the same forbidden behavior into alternate containers and computed/aliased references rather than varying only function names or operations.

transfer_cases.case: Move a prohibited mutation from an expression statement into a return or loop while preserving semantics.
Change direct member access to a computed or aliased reference while preserving semantics.

skill_changes.validation: Focused contract test passed and genericity validator is READY.
Focused adversarial contract test passed and genericity validator is READY.
